tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

Service charge quoted is more than minimum 2% and less than maximum 4%. If the service charge is quoted less than 2%, the EMD money of such tenderer will be forfeited. And the said firm will be blacklisted
all terms and conditions as per tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Experience Certificates: Experience certificates for providing outsourced human resources to government agencies during the years 2024-25 and 2025-26.
From the Labor Department: A certificate from the Labor Department (c) valid for the 2025-26 year.
From the PF Organization: A letter from the PF organization and payment challans from January 2026 to June 2026.
From the ESI Organization: Registration certificate from the ESI organization and payment challans from January 2026 to June 2026, both valid for the 2026-27 year.
Police Verification: A certificate from the Police Department stating that there are no criminal cases pending against the organization.
GST: GST registration certificate and recent GST return filing, including JAN -2026 TO JUNE-2026 GST-3B
Income Tax Return: Income tax certificate (ITR-5) for the years 2023-24 and 2024-25.
Financial Statements: Profit & Loss Account/Income & Expenditure statement and Balance Sheet for the years 2023-24 and 2024-25.
CA-Certified Documents: Attested copies of documents certified by a Chartered Accountant (CA) for the years 2023-24 and 2024-25, which should also have a UDI (Unique Document Identification) number.
